categories.main_business_segments: CATL is a global leading new energy technology company primarily engaged in the research, development, production and sales of power batteries, energy storage batteries, and battery recycling products. The company operates through two main business segments: power battery systems (71.15% of 2023 revenue) and energy storage battery systems (14.94% of 2023 revenue), along with battery materials and recycling operations (8.38% of revenue) and battery mineral resources (1.93% of revenue).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced electrochemistry and materials science, with focus on material and material system innovation, system structure innovation, and green extreme manufacturing. Key technologies include CTP (Cell to Pack) technology, CTC (Cell to Chassis) integration, and advanced manufacturing processes utilizing digital and intelligent methods. The company operates multiple research institutions including the National Engineering Research Center for Electrochemical Energy Storage Technology and maintains 8,137 domestic patents and 1,850 foreign patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CATL serves global automotive manufacturers including BMW, Daimler, Stellantis, Volkswagen, Ford, Hyundai, Honda, and Volvo, as well as domestic Chinese automakers like SAIC, Geely, NIO, Li Auto, and Xiaomi. In energy storage, the company partners with Fluence, Wärtsilä, Flexgen, Sungrow, and major Chinese state-owned energy companies. The company also serves commercial vehicle, engineering machinery, electric vessel, and consumer electronics markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: CATL operates globally with significant presence in China (67.33% of 2023 revenue), Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions. The company has manufacturing facilities in multiple Chinese provinces (Fujian, Jiangsu, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Liaoning, Zhejiang) and international locations including Germany, Hungary, Indonesia, Canada, and the United States. Overseas revenue represented 32.67% of total 2023 revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: CATL operates across the entire battery value chain as an integrated manufacturer. The company is positioned midstream to downstream, producing battery cells, modules, and complete battery systems for vehicle and energy storage applications. The company also operates upstream through investments in lithium, nickel, cobalt, and phosphorus mining and processing, including operations in Indonesia, Sichuan, and Hubei provinces.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus encompasses three major directions: replacing fossil fuels in stationary energy with electrochemical storage plus renewable energy, replacing fossil fuels in transportation with power batteries and electric vehicles, and promoting market application integration through electrification and intelligence. R&D priorities include developing high energy density, ultra-fast charging, high safety, and long-life battery products. Key innovation initiatives include the Condensed State Battery, Shenxing Battery for fast charging, sodium-ion batteries, M3P batteries, and Qilin batteries.
categories.revenue_model: CATL generates revenue primarily through product sales of battery systems and battery materials. The company sells power battery systems to automotive manufacturers, energy storage battery systems to power utilities and renewable energy companies, and battery materials to battery manufacturers. The company also generates revenue through battery recycling and mineral resource operations. Additionally, the company develops commercial models including battery swap services (EVOGO and Qiji), smart charging stations, and zero-carbon ecosystem solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CATL is the global market leader in both power and energy storage batteries. According to SNE Research, the company held 36.8% global power battery market share in 2023 (ranked first for 7 consecutive years) and 40% global energy storage battery market share (ranked first for 3 consecutive years). The company's domestic power battery market share was 44.5% in 2023. Key competitors include BYD, LG Energy Solution, and other emerging battery manufacturers globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: CATL is a large-scale, rapidly growing company with 2023 revenue of 400.92 billion yuan (22.01% growth from 2022), net profit of 44.12 billion yuan (43.58% growth), and total assets of 717.17 billion yuan. The company achieved 390 GWh battery sales volume in 2023 (34.95% growth). Operating cash flow reached 92.83 billion yuan in 2023 (51.65% growth). The company maintains strong profitability with net profit margin of 11.01% and ROE of 24.04%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CATL differentiates through technological leadership in battery chemistry and system design, offering products with superior energy density, charging speed, safety, and longevity. The company emphasizes extreme manufacturing capabilities achieving industry-leading quality and efficiency. Key differentiators include proprietary battery chemistries (Condensed State, M3P, sodium-ion), innovative system architectures (CTP, CTC), and comprehensive solutions spanning battery supply, battery swap services, and zero-carbon ecosystem development. The company's ESG leadership (MSCI A rating, S&P ESG score improvement, Sustainalytics low risk) and commitment to zero-carbon operations by 2025 (core operations) and 2035 (value chain) provide additional competitive advantage.
